message.voicedoor.no_owner: This door has no owner yet. Look at it and run /voicedoor register to claim it.
message.voicedoor.not_owner: Only the owner of this door can do that.
message.voicedoor.cooldown: Wait %s more second(s) before trying again.
message.voicedoor.no_voicechat: Simple Voice Chat is not installed, so voice cannot be recorded.
message.voicedoor.session_busy: A recording is already in progress. Wait for it to finish.
message.voicedoor.server_busy: The voice server is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
message.voicedoor.door_gone: The door was removed while you were speaking.
message.voicedoor.speak_now: Speak into your microphone for %s seconds...
message.voicedoor.speak_phrase: Say this out loud: §e%s§r (you have %s seconds)
message.voicedoor.no_audio: No audio was received. Is your microphone working and voice chat unmuted?
message.voicedoor.too_little_audio: Not enough speech was captured. Speak a little longer.
message.voicedoor.accepted: Voice recognized as §e%s§r (%s%% match). Door open!
message.voicedoor.reason_low_score: Match was only %s%%, below the required %s%%.
message.voicedoor.register_tip: Tip: record 3-5 times, speaking naturally for a few seconds each time.
message.voicedoor.sample_saved: Sample saved (%s s) for §e%s§r - %s sample(s) total.
message.voicedoor.enrolled: Voiceprint for §e%s§r is ready. The door can be used now.
message.voicedoor.now_owner: You are now the owner of this door.
message.voicedoor.cannot_register_other: You can only register your own voice on this door.
message.voicedoor.look_at_door: Look directly at a VoiceDoor first.
message.voicedoor.players_only: This command can only be used by a player.
message.voicedoor.denied: %s may no longer use this door.
message.voicedoor.not_allowed: %s was not on the allow list.
message.voicedoor.bad_url: The URL must start with http:// or https://
message.voicedoor.token_saved: API token saved (%s characters). It is not shown here on purpose.
message.voicedoor.token_cleared: API token cleared. Requests will be sent without authentication.
message.voicedoor.help_register: /voicedoor register [name] - record a voice sample for the door you are looking at
message.voicedoor.help_info: /voicedoor info - show details about that door
message.voicedoor.help_allow: /voicedoor allow <player> - let another player use your door
message.voicedoor.help_setapi: /voicedoor setapi <url> - point the mod at a different API server
message.voicedoor.help_enroll: /voicedoor enroll <member> - rebuild a voiceprint from stored samples
